description: This PHP source file defines the ContentType class within the Todaymade\Daux\ContentTypes\Markdown namespace. It implements methods for handling Markdown content, including conversion to HTML, caching, and file extension management.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Implements Markdown content processing including conversion, caching, and extension handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ContentType with a Config object.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a new CommonMarkConverter instance configured with the current page's configuration.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Returns the existing converter or creates a new one if not initialized.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of file extensions associated with Markdown.

methods.name: doConversion
methods.description: Converts raw Markdown text into HTML content and logs the process.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Handles conversion of raw Markdown to HTML with caching support.
